How Window Film To Block Heat Works

How window film blocks heat works is that the film is made up of particles designed to reflect the sun’s rays away from your windows, preventing the heat from entering your car. Window film can reduce heat in your car by over 80% so it is an effective way to keep your car cool.

Our Spectre window film to block heat tint is an example of a heat rejection film featuring innovative ceramic film technology that offers the highest infrared heat rejection compared to any of our other films.

Another way that window film can block heat is through absorption. Our high-performance window film to block heat, Black Panther, is a world-leading Hybrid-Matrix Nano-Ceramic technology film constructed with multiple heat-absorbing nano-ceramic layers. These layers work together dynamically to trap infrared heat, offering maximum heat rejection so you can enjoy the ultimate comfort inside your car. Black Panther also has zero signal interference with your favourite electronic devices too.
